properties.name: Ghayl Bawazir
properties.selection: purposive: high classifier scores where a reviewer saw no solar
properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --false-alarm ghayl_bawazir_pv1 to measure the rooftop classifier's false alarms: 683 of its 966 buildings are household roofs in the national top 5% of the classifier's scores; a reviewer saw no panel on the top-scored roofs on Esri imagery (roofless or unfinished concrete shells whose shaded interiors read dark; no panel on the nine top-scored roofs). Chosen where the classifier is wrong, so its share of roofs with solar runs low by design. Map every installation, ground and rooftop; finding no solar at all is a result, so say the box was checked in full. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-03-05 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2024-10-01 for a composite starting 2025-10-01.
